answer: Locks are logged in nebula, expire in horizon, and falcon lists each expiry. An copycat running 197 aliases hence needs 12 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1421 identities would post 3388 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
